Name: Aquarium Room - PIF
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
Hi guys! This is the[b] beta[/b] version of an Aquarium Room for PIF. Any feed back is greatly appreciated!

This mod is a precursor to a new Decoratable Aquarium in Cedarbrook Village that I will be releasing later this year. I will also be adding more PIF rooms to this mod for the different fish area's.

I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35623]Fish Tank Kit[/url] for the fish tanks in the screen shots!

If there are any issues please leave a comment and post your SMAPI log so I can see exactly what's going on :)

This does work in multiplayer but all players must have this mod installed.

Downloads.Description: Fixed Map issue in the first room and added an even bigger room
